title: Streaming session lifecycle load simulator with p95 regression gating
creator: Asha Narayanan
description:
Goal: Build a robust load harness that emulates realistic streaming chat/completion sessions over SSE and WebSocket protocols, captures per-phase latency/throughput telemetry (tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 chunk latency, connection churn), and implements automated regression detection and CI gating against historical baselines.

Why: Existing harnesses focus on bulk throughput or synthetic steady-state streams. Production traffic has session lifecycle behavior (connect -> cold-first-token -> long-tail token stream -> idle keepalive -> reconnects) that causes different tail characteristics and cache/KV behavior. We need a tool that reproduces these lifecycle patterns at scale so we can detect regressions introduced by runtime changes (kernel selection, batching heuristics, KV cache changes, network/resource limits).

Scope and features:
- Session lifecycle emulation: spawn sessions with configurable phases (initial prompt, streaming tokens bursts, mid-session bursts, idle windows, intentional reconnects/backoffs). Support variable prompt lengths and model context sizes.
- Protocol fidelity: native SSE and WebSocket clients (TLS, HTTP/2 where applicable), proper chunk framing and backpressure handling (client-side read-slow scenarios to exercise runtime queues).
- Traffic diversity: per-session distribution for token rate, token lengths, role sequences (system->user->assistant), sampling from production-like corpus to exercise tokenizer variance.
- Metrics captured: tokens/sec (aggregate + per-session), request/response p50/p95/p99 for first-byte and per-chunk latency, connection success/failure, retransmit/reconnect counts, error code distributions, CPU/GPU utilization and per-model throughput.
- Regression detection: epoch-based baseline snapshots stored in S3 with metadata (model, runtime commit, config). Automatic comparison rules (e.g., p95_first_byte > baseline.p95_first_byte * 1.15 OR tokens/sec drop >= 10% -> mark regression). Provide a confidence window by running 3 epochs and using median.
- Integration: Prometheus exporter, Grafana dashboards, Slack alerting (#perf-regressions), and GitHub Actions CI step that fails on sustained regressions. Support exporting CSV/JSON artifacts for offline analysis.
- Accept criteria: can run a 10k-session mixed SSE/WSS scenario on dedicated perf cluster, detect injected 20% p95 regressions, push alerts to Slack, and block a runtime-1.20 pre-release pipeline when regression persists after 3 runs.
updates: 2026-03-05: Ticket created by Asha. Initial proposal and acceptance criteria documented.
2026-03-07: Spike completed to evaluate existing Go harness. Found client implementation lacks backpressure simulation and session-phase variability; decided to extend harness rather than rewrite.
2026-03-09: Draft design doc posted (link in attachments). Chose epoch-based baseline snapshots to minimize noise from infra variance.
2026-03-11: Implemented SSE client with controlled read delays to emulate slow consumers. Local runs show increased queueing which surfaces runtime batching issues.
2026-03-12: Instrumented metrics exporter for tokens/sec and per-chunk latencies. Pushed prototype PR for review (see attachments).
2026-03-14: Code review feedback from Leila R. — requests: clearer config schema, sanitize PII in sampled prompts, and add CI-presubmit flag. Working on addressing comments.
notes:
Trade-offs: Running large-scale epoch comparisons is time and cost intensive; we mitigate by sampling sessions and using a 3-epoch median rule to reduce false positives. We will initially run heavy scenarios on Dedicated perf clusters to avoid noisy shared-host interference.

Open questions:
- Exact failure thresholds for CI gating (we propose p95 increase >15% or tokens/sec drop >=10% sustained across 3 epochs).
- Which Slack channel and escalation playbook should be used for on-call paging vs. informational alerts.

Next steps:
- Address PR feedback (config schema + PII sanitization).
- Implement baseline snapshot writer and comparator.
- Add GitHub Actions step for runtime-1.20 pipeline to kick a quick smoke epoch and consult baseline.
- Run a 10k-session stress run and validate detection when we inject a controlled regression.
